decisions.reason: A high-resolution piezo inkjet printer was launched only in 2018 and fits the firm's core coding portfolio and its push toward serialization, so its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little, and the option should stay open.

The numbering software module is a low-cost extension of the firm's software portfolio for variable data printing that supports its traceability strategy, so there is no reason to abandon the option this early.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces addresses a clear customer need in packaging marking and builds on the firm's in-house ink expertise, so with prospects still unresolved and little cost to keep, it should stay on the market.
